description: A pipeline that is green because it does not run the check it names. Three independent ways absence looks like success.

defects.tell: pull_request paths: legacy/** matches nothing in this tree, so the workflow never runs
pytest test/ (singular) collects nothing; tests live in tests/
python -m pytest test/ | tee pytest.log reports tee's exit code
the security job exits 1 under continue-on-error, so a red check is a green workflow

production_bug.tell: add(1,1) returns 3. tests/test_app.py would catch this if CI ran it.
